263s9: Small, early-game save · quick to load, easy to get your bearings — every layer this app can render, kept simple
bad-land: A long-running survival world · 6,300+ structures, 28,000+ chests, and 690+ villagers found — what the map looks like once you've actually lived in it
large-biome: A real save on a non-default world type · Large Biomes shifts structure spacing and biome scale from the default — this lets you check cubiomes' predictions against what actually generated, not just trust a seed-only guess

Chickenfeet: Another real survival save · a second data point alongside Bad Land for chest loot, entities, and POI density on a default-type world
